findings.title: Bring the administrator file task above routine management disclosures on mobile
findings.visible_evidence: Operations & audit, Create shared workspace and Leavers precede search and the task beginning near y560. Only two complete file rows are initially visible; the empty-folder guidance continues below844px. This is the local administrator fixture only.
findings.impact: The common file task spends most of the first phone viewport on management chrome; it is the material reason I do not yet independently endorse this baseline.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep every administrator capability and its authorization, but group these existing disclosures into one collapsed Administration disclosure or position the existing group after the current file task. Avoid a second sidebar.
findings.candidate_source: web/src/pages/Drive.tsx (candidate owner from file inventory; implementation not inspected)

findings.title: Use one primary Upload emphasis in the empty desktop folder
findings.visible_evidence: Upload files appears filled orange both at the toolbar right and at the center of the empty state.
findings.impact: Both routes remain understandable; duplicate primary emphasis weakens hierarchy rather than blocking the task.
findings.smallest_fix: Retain both existing actions but make the empty-state action secondary while keeping the toolbar primary.

findings.title: Reduce completion emphasis in the empty Share form
findings.visible_evidence: Done is the filled orange footer action while Create link is outlined beside the expiry control. No recipient or link exists yet.
findings.impact: The view makes closing more prominent than the available sharing action; the labels remain clear.
findings.smallest_fix: Make Done a quiet exit. Consider contextually emphasizing the existing Create link action only when that branch is being used, preserving safe defaults and recipient/link behavior.

findings.title: Remove the idle folder icon accent
findings.visible_evidence: The Project materials folder icon uses orange even though the row is not selected; other document icons are neutral.
findings.impact: Small brand-discipline mismatch; the file list remains readable.
findings.smallest_fix: Use neutral ink for the idle folder icon, reserving orange for primary/selected/focus states.

findings.title: Give the visible disabled credential action a distinct neutral treatment
findings.visible_evidence: Create app password keeps a faded orange fill below the empty Device or app name field; the MFA primary remains strongly filled above.
findings.impact: The disabled state is discernible, but faded-primary styling falls short of the pinned control contract. The button is outside the mobile capture and is not scored there.
findings.smallest_fix: Use a visibly disabled neutral variant for this control while retaining its existing disabled behavior; verify every named theme during implementation.
